name: Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9)

stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

items.text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

scoring.note: The total is the sum of the nine item scores, as the form's office-coding line adds its columns. The form prints no worked example, and the form prints no severity bands: G6 reports the score computed and nothing more.

to_a_person.why: G6's own rule: the item asks about thoughts of being better off dead or of self-harm, so any answer other than 0 goes to a person with the crisis response and the directory, whatever the total.

unscored.text: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
unscored.note: The form prints no score for this question; it is not part of the total and is not taken as an input.
